 Food recall expanded to include breakfast sandwiches, sausage gravy sold in Arkansas
 By 
 Staff 
 November 19, 2026 
 A Texas food manufacturer has expanded a recall of breakfast products distributed in Arkansas and several other states because of possible Listeria contamination.
 Fresh & Ready Foods LLC announced the expanded recall November 17 after learning that certain biscuit products used in its meals were included in a separate recall by C.H. Guenther & Son.
 The recall includes Fresh To You Sausage, Egg & Cheese Biscuit Sandwiches, weighing 5.7 ounces, and Mmm! Meals Made in Minutes Biscuit & Sausage Gravy, weighing 9.5 ounces.
 The affected products were manufactured at the company’s Longview, Texas, facility and distributed between October 15 and November 11 through employee break rooms, Grab & Go coolers, refrigerated vending machines and micro-markets.
 The Fresh To You sandwiches have SKU number 3100048 and fresh-through dates ranging from November 12 through November 22. The Meals Made in Minutes sausage gravy products have SKU number 90013 and expiration dates ranging from November 12 through November 18. The dates and product information can be found on the front labels.
 The products were distributed in Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Oklahoma, Tennessee and Texas, with the breakfast sandwiches also distributed in Alabama.
 Listeria can cause serious and sometimes fatal infections in young children, older adults, pregnant women and people with weakened immune systems. No illnesses had been reported in connection with the recall as of the company’s announcement.
 Consumers are urged not to eat the affected products and to discard any remaining items. Those seeking a full refund or additional information can contact Fresh & Ready Foods at 1-855-424-8390, Monday through Friday, from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Eastern time, or by email at RecallConcern@HotLineGlobal.com.
